card.name: Digits in physical data tables
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or the decimal point at the start of a small decimal value in a data table of physical or dosimetry constants. Also the R in an insulation rating such as R-20.

modes.label: Decimals in tables
modes.description: A leading 0 or the decimal point in a numeric table of organ-wall values or material properties.

modes.label: Insulation rating
modes.description: The R or number in an R-value for insulation.
